reason: E1 provides a thermodynamic ranking supporting Al2O3 and SiO2 stability over Mn oxides, and E4 shows Al2O3 and Cr2O3 form a protective scale in AlCoCrFeNi, but no cited evidence directly demonstrates that Si forms a protective SiO2 scale in CrFeCoNiSi, nor that Mn oxides cause faster growth and spallation in CrFeCoNiMn; E2 and E3 are irrelevant to the CrFeCoNiX system.
premises: Al and Si form thermodynamically stable, slow-growing, adherent oxides (Al2O3, SiO2) that limit cation diffusion and stress
Mn forms less protective, volatile oxides that lead to rapid scale growth and stress accumulation
Cr2O3 contributes to a protective scale when combined with Al2O3 or SiO2
Thermodynamic stability of oxides (Al2O3 > SiO2 > MnO > Cr2O3) governs protective behavior
Oxide growth kinetics and stress development control cracking/spallation
